basic_details.job_title: LUVAS Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 27 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Lala Lajpat Rai University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Hisar (LUVAS) has announced temporary vacancies, including 2 Teaching Associate posts, under advertisement number LUVAS/COVS/TA/2026/01. Eligible applicants can apply through the prescribed offline process by submitting the filled application form with self-attested copies of testimonials, certificates, publications and other required documents either by hand or through post to The Dean COVS, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana on or before 31 October 2026. The required qualification for the Teaching Associate post is M.V.Sc./M.Sc. in Animal Gene

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated in due course on the official website

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Agronomy/Plant Breeding (Bachelor's in Agriculture Sciences from ICAR recognized institute)
Veterinary and Animal Husbandry Extension Education

qualification.details: Essential Qualifications: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences (B.V.Sc. & A.H. / B.V.Sc.) from a VCI-recognized university/college/institute (for Sr. No. 2, Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture Sciences from an ICAR-recognized institute). Candidates must also hold a Master's Degree in the relevant subject of Veterinary Sciences, Animal Sciences, or Agriculture Sciences (for Sr. No. 2) recognized by VCI/ICAR. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Duly filled application forms complete in all respects along with self-attested photocopies of required certificates, documents, and publications must reach “The Dean COVS, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana-125004” either by hand or through post on or before 31.10.2026 up to 05:00 PM. Candidates must mention the title on the envelope as “Application for the position of Teaching Associate in the College of Veterinary Sciences vide Advt. No. LUVAS/COVS/TA/2026/01”. Separate application forms must be submitted for each position if applying for multiple types of positions.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Sciences (B.V.Sc. & A.H. / B.V.Sc.) from a VCI-recognized university/college/institute (for Sr. No. 2, Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture Sciences from an ICAR-recognized institute). Candidates must also hold a Master's Degree in the relevant subject of Veterinary Sciences, Animal Sciences, or Agriculture Sciences (for Sr. No. 2) recognized by VCI/ICAR. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of essential academic qualifications, final mark sheets, and certificates indicating percentage of marks/OGPA. Certificate showing Date of Birth. Self-attested copy of relevant reservation category certificates (OSC, DSC, BC-A, BC-B, EWS, ESM, PWD). Haryana Residence Certificate, where applicable. List of University Level Academic Awards (Gold Medal, etc.) with self-attested proofs. Documentary proof of NAAS-rated publications. Experience certificates and other supporting testimonials as mentioned in the application form. Aadhar card copy. Latest passport-size coloured photograph showing 80% face visible, duly signed by the candidate, pasted on the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic qualifications, additional qualifications, a PowerPoint presentation, and an interview, distributed across a total of 100 marks as follows: Bachelor's Degree: Maximum 20 marks (on pro-rata system) Master's Degree: Maximum 20 marks (on pro-rata system) Doctoral Degree: Maximum 10 marks (on pro-rata system) Additional Qualifications: Maximum 15 marks (5 marks for University Level Academic Awards like Gold Medal; 10 marks for publications with 1 mark each for NAAS rating ≥6 and 0.5 each for NAAS rating <6) PowerPoint Presentation: Maximum 15 marks (on any topic as undergraduate teacher, preference of the candidate) Performance in Interview: Maximum 20 marks

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for LUVAS Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form to The Dean COVS, LUVAS, Hisar is 31.10.2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly honorarium paid to Teaching Associates at LUVAS?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are paid a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs. 60,000/- (Rupees Sixty Thousand only) with no other allowances or benefits.

faq.question: Q3. Is this job permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary, non-regular, non-tenurial, time-bound, and co-terminus with the Academic Year (July to June) i.e., in June 2027, not exceeding one year.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates from other states apply for reserved category positions?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to other than Haryana State will be treated as General category candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection procedure for these positions?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-mark criteria comprising evaluation of Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, Doctoral degree, additional qualifications/publications, a PowerPoint presentation, and an interview.
